_meta.warning: Each energy source below embeds an emission factor object with the same DEMO_PLACEHOLDER status as emission_factors.json (they are the same underlying values, duplicated here for direct UI/API consumption). See emission_factors.json for the canonical factor catalog, including process-route and alloy factors not listed as top-level energy sources here.
_meta.schema_note: Each source carries: id, name, type (electricity|fuel), description, and an embedded emission_factor object (name, value, unit, year, geography, boundary, scope, source, confidence, notes).

sources.name: Grid Electricity
sources.description: Electricity drawn from the public grid, location-based accounting.

emission_factor.name: Grid Electricity (India) - CO2 intensity
emission_factor.source: DEMO_PLACEHOLDER - not drawn from CEA CO2 Baseline Database or any verified registry

sources.name: Renewable Electricity
sources.description: Electricity from a renewable PPA or captive solar/wind generation.

emission_factor.name: Renewable Electricity (Solar/Wind PPA or captive) - CO2 intensity
